package frontend

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestPulseDiscoveryBlockTime(t *testing.T) {
	block := &backend.BlockMeta{StartTime: time.Unix(10, 0), EndTime: time.Unix(21, 0)}
	type Case struct {
		Start    int64 `json:"start"`
		End      int64 `json:"end"`
		Included bool  `json:"included"`
	}
	cases := []Case{{9, 9, false}, {9, 10, true}, {15, 16, true}, {21, 21, true}, {22, 23, false}}
	for _, c := range cases {
		got := blockMetasForSearch([]*backend.BlockMeta{block}, time.Unix(c.Start, 0), time.Unix(c.End, 0), func(*backend.BlockMeta) bool { return true })
		if (len(got) == 1) != c.Included {
			t.Fatal(c)
		}
	}
	raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-intrinsics/time-routing-oracle.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
